question: Chuni Goswami, on whose name a commemorative stamp was issued by the Indian Postal Department, was a professional Indian _______ player.
solution:
The correct answer is __**football**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chuni Goswami**, on whose name a commemorative stamp was issued by the Indian Postal Department, was a professional **Indian football player.**
 
• Chuni Goswami, the Indian Football stalwart who led India to win the gold medal in the 1962__ Asian Games in Bangkok was honoured by the Indian Postal Department.
 
• The Dept issued a postal stamp on his **82nd birthday (January 15, 2020).**
 
• Chuni-da is the third Indian footballer after the late Gostho Paul (1998), and the late Dr Talimeren Ao (2018) on whose name a postal stamp has been issued.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b907bfb1e6f7e97232ef0f4f2739187fecb882accb8f0caa0633e12454389e0.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Sunil Chhetri** was a National football player in India.

 
 
• He was the captain of the Indian national football team.
 
 
 
• Gurpreet Singh is an Indian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper.
 
• Bhaichung Bhutia is a former Indian professional footballer who played as a striker.
